purpose: Provide the single Book-parent immutable version ledger and restore boundary for canonical Book state. Every accepted parent successor is digest-bound to its exact predecessor; governed object versions are immutable; current pointer changes are exact-version-bound; rollback restores historical content only by committing a new successor after current dependency/authority revalidation; historical state and evidence are never rewritten or deleted.

authority.rule: External/child outputs and author choices become parent evidence/decision objects through their registered boundaries; this engine only commits already-authorized parent successor state and cannot manufacture those authorities.

rules: expected parent and ledger identities must match the exact current committed identities.
The engine assigns the next state_version and state_digest; callers cannot select or reuse a historical state identity.
Existing object-version identities are immutable; same object type/id/version with different payload digest fails closed.
Every newly observed object version receives a predecessor_node_id when the object family already has history.
Every active pointer must bind to one exact object-version node present in the proposed aggregate.

If project lifecycle status changes, lifecycle_transition_receipt must prove the exact current-to-proposed transition and parent identities; Version/Rollback does not independently authorize lifecycle changes.
Existing author decisions, integration proposals, research evidence and export release entries cannot be removed or modified in place by a successor commit.
A canonical manuscript binding requires authority_state=CANONICAL and exact sha256 artifact_digest.
The target must exist in state_snapshots and match exact target state_version/state_digest.
Restore never makes the historical target current in place; it creates a new successor with new state_version/state_digest and predecessor equal to the pre-restore current state.

RESTORE_CONTENT restores governed content collections and active bindings from the target while preserving the current project lifecycle status and all current evidence/decision/proposal/export history.
RESTORE_CONTENT is forbidden while current project status is EXPORT_FROZEN, PUBLISHED_OR_DELIVERED or ARCHIVED; the project must first be reopened through qualified lifecycle authority.

RESTORE_FULL_STATE may reproduce the target project status only when an exact lifecycle_transition_receipt authorizes that status change. If target status is EXPORT_FROZEN or PUBLISHED_OR_DELIVERED, current explicit export/publication authority evidence is additionally required; otherwise fail closed.
Every active binding that changes must have an exact revalidation binding_check for the target node and at least one current evidence/dependency reference.
rights_privacy_current must be true and critical_evidence_resolved must be true.

When author_decision_required is true, every referenced author decision must already exist in the current parent state and be APPROVED with an affirmative author choice. The restore engine never creates or upgrades a decision.
Newer object versions not selected by the restore remain in immutable history and are not deleted.

append_only_history.rule: Entries present in the current state may be carried into successors and additional separately-authorized entries may be appended, but Version/Rollback cannot delete or change an existing entry's payload under the same identity.

concurrency_and_replay.persistent_adapter_rule: Use one local transaction with SERIALIZABLE or equivalent conditional-write semantics; serialization/conflict failures do not permit silent semantic merge.

transactionality.logical_commit: new parent state snapshot + new object-version nodes + version receipt + outbox entry commit atomically
transactionality.failure_rule: On any validation or commit failure, the input parent state and ledger remain unchanged and no partial history/outbox entry is exposed.

lifecycle_dependency_boundary.rule: This boundary does not replace Lifecycle Transition Engine v1. A project-status change must be backed by an exact lifecycle transition receipt. RESTORE_CONTENT normally leaves status unchanged.

publication_boundary.rule: Rollback or restoration never synthesizes export freeze, publication authorization or production authority. Historical export/proof/publication records remain historical evidence unless separately revalidated under current Book publication rules.

qualification_objective: Prove immutable complete-state and object-version lineage; exact active-version binding; no in-place historical mutation; exact digest mismatch failure; stale/concurrent write rejection; idempotent replay and identity conflict; append-only evidence preservation; lifecycle-status authority separation; RESTORE_CONTENT as a new successor; full-state restore fail-closed without exact lifecycle/publication evidence; dependency/currentness and author-decision revalidation; branch-like divergence preservation; partial-failure atomicity; re-forward after restore; and exact rollback receipt identity on one exact subject SHA.
qualification_effect: NONE until the executable implementation, deterministic adversarial fixtures and a registered exact-SHA qualification pass.
